This supplies data for closed history and object-role regression tests. Its
identities, ACLs, PID/birth pairs and expected root facts are historical inputs;
they establish no current filesystem custody, holder termination, SYSTEM
execution, service ownership, native retirement or release qualification.
The test calls only the byte/history decoders and never the native retirement
owner. Recorded E:paths and volume GUIDs must never be reopened.
